sources.observation: NLM documents that a baseline labelled year R is released in December after records are maintained to year R's MeSH and contains the preceding production year's updates. The source contract therefore requires releases 2007, 2011, 2012, and 2013 to cover publication-year cutoffs 2006, 2010, 2011, and 2012. Official NLM inventory pages are pinned for all four releases. A digest-addressed Common Crawl WARC capture of the MBR homepage also preserves the historical Download/Baselines/{year} directory links and matching release totals. This metadata establishes directory and completeness targets only: the mbr.nlm.nih.gov host no longer resolves, and no required XML payload or per-file checksum has been recovered. A 2026-08-07 follow-up checked plausible public NCBI archive paths, the preserved directory URL, and the title/abstract-only BioNLP snapshot service without acquiring a suitable payload; the dated negative search is recorded in plans/reports/source-search-260807-historical-medline.md. On 2026-08-10, NLM Support confirmed in a private reply that baseline files for previous years are not available and directed the requester to the current baseline directory. The repository retains only the public-safe summary above, not personal correspondence or identifiers. NLM's launch notice says the raw FTP and query tool were originally controlled for registered licensees.
sources.next_action: Keep the original four-release source gate unavailable unless a separately verifiable preserved copy is recovered. The dated BioASQ 2013 secondary snapshot is pinned under source-alternatives.json; its aggregate counts match but its publication scope does not, and it cannot silently replace the original NLM-baseline contract. Its bounded semantics result and frozen 21-case pilot both contribute zero historical readiness. Run the pilot's score-free source-compatibility gate before freezing any formula or computing a rank.
